name: gamehub
description: Discover, play, create locally, validate and publish MOOYU.FUN games from supported AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Discover, play, and create lightweight games / 发现、游玩和创作轻量游戏
interface.longDescription: Use the complete hosted MOOYU.FUN interface in supported Agents, with a safe fallback to the official website when the host cannot embed it. 在支持的 Agent 中使用完整的墨鱼工坊界面；宿主无法安全内置时回退到官方网页。
defaultPrompt: Open MOOYU.FUN and help me choose a short game to play now. / 打开墨鱼工坊，帮我选择一款适合现在玩的短游戏。
Use the MOOYU.FUN creator tools to make a game in the current workspace. / 使用墨鱼工坊创作工具，在当前工作区制作一款游戏。
